prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: review-only modular character anatomy/style board for the original dark-fantasy FPS-RPG Caelum Argenteum, issue #736 under #458. This is concept artwork, not a claim of an existing 3D mesh.
Input images: image 1 (human_male_plain_v1) is the owned male identity and base-clothing reference; image 2 (human_female_idle_v1) supplies only the owned female face/hair identity, NOT the armor or weapons; image 3 (body_plain_female_module_v1) supplies the female plain outfit; image 4 (modular.png engine capture) is only the accepted Domingo reference for grounded 3D material rendering and realistic adult proportions. Do not copy the game environment or interface.
Primary request: one clean landscape comparison board, HUMAN family, showing exactly six full-body standing figures. Top row: the same adult male in FRONT, PROFILE, BACK views. Bottom row: the same adult female in FRONT, PROFILE, BACK views. Orthographic-like presentation, identical scale within each row, complete heads and soles visible, relaxed neutral stance with arms slightly away from the torso so clothing seams and hands are readable. All are unmistakably adult, realistically proportioned, ordinary capable physiques rather than exaggerated superhero anatomy.
Style: polished 3D character concept render, believable anatomical joints, natural faces and hands, restrained dark-fantasy realism, fine cloth/leather texture, soft neutral studio light. No pixel art or chibi proportions. Neutral light gray background, restrained dark lettering, no environmental props.
Clothing: both sexes use only the reference plain ivory/cream long-sleeved lace-collar shirt, loose dark charcoal trousers, simple brown leather belt, separate brown leather gloves and calf boots. Modest practical fit; female shirt/trousers are functional and fully covering. No armor, scarf, cape, jewelry, weapon or shield. Natural tan skin, brown hair; preserve distinct referenced male/female identities and visible real head anatomy. Hair is its own future module, not sculpted into the shirt. Shirt, trousers, belt, gloves and boots must read as distinct removable garments. This proposal does not set numeric heights or gameplay characteristics.
Layout and exact text: title "HUMAN / STYLE PROPOSAL"; small subtitle "Concept only - pending author review"; top-row label "MALE", bottom-row label "FEMALE"; column labels "FRONT", "PROFILE", "BACK". No other text. Keep generous spacing and crisp detail; no borders cutting through bodies. All views must preserve the same clothes, hairstyle, identity and proportions.
